title: Page timing at 375px
notes: TIER IS WATCH, NOT GATE (design §4.7: 'watch → gate'), same reason as touch-targets (builder A8): this worktree has no dev server or DATABASE_URL (standing 'a worktree has no .env.local either' gotcha), so e2e/bench-page-timing.spec.ts could not actually be run here to establish today's real numbers. Promote to gate once a CI run with a live server + seeded cohort (npx tsx scripts/bench/seed-cohort.ts) confirms real p95s under the floor. The 800ms floor on every metric is design §4.7's adopted default (plan item 1, floors marked †) applied uniformly to both server-response (p95_ttfb_ms_*, Navigation Timing's responseStart) and DOMContentLoaded (p95_dcl_ms_*, domContentLoadedEventEnd) for each of the four hottest pages named in the task brief — the student home (/dashboard), the student jobs page (/career — /jobs is a redirect stub to /career#jobs, the repo's retired-route pattern), the teacher dashboard (/teacher), and the Connect console (/teacher/connect). Each metric is a p95 over REPEATS=8 repeated navigations (e2e/bench-page-timing.spec.ts's REPEATS, raised from 5 in PR review round 2), read from the freshly-loaded document's own Navigation Timing entry after each goto, with one additional untimed warm-up navigation per route discarded before those 8 (also round 2 — without it the FIRST of the timed samples was the page's genuinely cold first load, which scripts/lib/percentile.mjs's nearest-rank p95 then reported literally verbatim as 'p95', since ceil(0.95*n) equals n for any n<20 — see that file). WHICH SAMPLE p95 IS: at REPEATS=8, p95 resolves via nearest-rank to index 7 of 8 (0-indexed) — i.e. the MAXIMUM of the 8 timed, post-warm-up samples, not a true fractional-rank tail statistic (that needs n>=20, well beyond what a per-PR e2e budget can afford at 4 pages x 8 navigations x 2 roles). This is honest about the ceiling: 'p95' here means 'the slowest of 8 warm loads', a meaningfully different (much better) number than 'the cold first load' but not the same claim a 20+-sample p95 would make.
